description: ALTER TABLE's column-action LIST, live-verified: {ALTER | MODIFY} [(] [COLUMN] c1 action [, [COLUMN] c2 action]* [)] with COLUMN optional per item and the parens optional; the list is ATOMIC (a failing second item leaves the first unapplied); IF EXISTS forgives ONLY the named table's absence - a missing schema still errors and so does an error the action itself raises. Converted 1:1 from features/AlterColumnListTest (now retired).
